{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.70

|gr1= Multiplayer

|serverExec= server

|descr= This is dedicated server command, which queries the admin state of any client on the network by their client ([[owner]]) id.
{{Feature|informative|To self-check the admin state of a local client, use [[BIS_fnc_admin]].}}

|s1= [[admin]] ownerID

|p1= ownerID: [[Number]] - [[clientOwner]] id

|r1= [[Number]] - admin state of given client:
* 0 - client is not an admin
* 1 - client is admin that is [[Arma 3: Server Config File#Voted_In_Admin|voted in]]
* 2 - client is admin that is [[Arma 3: Server Config File#Logged_In_Admin|logged in]]

|x1= <sqf>private _isLoggedInAdmin = admin 3 == 2;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>private _adminState = admin owner unit1;</sqf>

|seealso= [[serverCommand]] [[serverCommandAvailable]] [[owner]] [[clientOwner]] [[remoteExecutedOwner]]
}}
